changes.after: A Boolean is either true or false. PHP has rules for turning text into a Boolean.

before: In a boolean context, false, null, numeric zero, the empty string, the string "0", and an empty array are false. Other nonempty strings such as "false" are true.
&& evaluates its right side only if the left side is true. || evaluates its right side only if the left side is false.
The explicit (bool) cast shows the conversion in this example. It is not a parser for human words such as yes or false.
